cases.label: window edges on each half independently: customer rows at @NewCutoff and @LastCutoff, supplier rows at @LastCutoff + 1 µs and @NewCutoff + 1 µs
cases.reasoning: Each half of the UNION ALL has its own WHERE. Customer 1 at @NewCutoff (in), customer 2 at @LastCutoff (out), supplier 1 1 µs after @LastCutoff (in), supplier 2 1 µs after @NewCutoff (out), supplier 3 at @NewCutoff (in). A conversion that filtered only one half, or applied the window after the union with a different bound, would differ.
